summary: The ProfileHistory feature in the HSPnet application manages the display and filtering of staff profile records based on different sections. It includes functionalities for selecting different sections such as post-employment education, training, documents, etc., and updating the display accordingly.
purpose: The purpose of the ProfileHistory feature is to allow users to view and manage different sections of staff profile records in a structured and filtered manner.

workflows.name: Display and Filter Staff Profile
steps: Retrieve StaffPRHistoryList based on UserSession and StaffID.
Check if the screen section (selected item) is null; if so, set to 'ALL'.
Update lblScreenSection with the section label.
Clear and repopulate ddScreenSection dropdown with applicable sections.

business_rules: The section dropdown is populated only with available sections based on the user's data.
The default dropdown value is 'ALL' if no section is selected.
conditions: If item is null, screenSection is set to 'ALL'.
Sections are added to ddScreenSection only if EntryExistsOfType returns true.
system_behavior: Displays staff profile records filtered by selected section.
Allows printing of details through btnPrintDetails.
